table_description: Fact table recording every line-item purchase made through the catalog channel (phone orders, mail orders). This is a complex fact table with ~34 columns — it tracks both the billing customer and a separate ship-to customer, call center handling, catalog page, shipping mode, and warehouse. At SF100TCL scale this contains approximately 144 billion rows.
use_cases: Catalog channel revenue and profit analysis
Call center performance and sales attribution
Shipping mode preference and cost analysis
Billing vs shipping address geography comparisons
Catalog page and catalog number effectiveness
Cross-channel comparison with store and web sales
data_quality_notes: CS_SOLD_DATE_SK can be NULL — always handle NULLs in date joins.
CATALOG_SALES has BOTH a billing customer (CS_BILL_CUSTOMER_SK) and a shipping customer (CS_SHIP_CUSTOMER_SK) — they can differ (gift orders). Use CS_BILL_CUSTOMER_SK for revenue attribution.
CS_ORDER_NUMBER groups multiple line items into one order — use it to count distinct orders.
CS_NET_PROFIT can be negative (sold below cost).
CS_EXT_SHIP_COST is additional shipping cost on top of the item price — include it when calculating total order cost.
This table is partitioned on CS_SOLD_DATE_SK — always include a date filter.
Join to CALL_CENTER using CS_CALL_CENTER_SK = CC_CALL_CENTER_SK.
Join to CATALOG_PAGE using CS_CATALOG_PAGE_SK = CP_CATALOG_PAGE_SK.
Join to WAREHOUSE using CS_WAREHOUSE_SK = W_WAREHOUSE_SK.

table_columns.name: CS_SOLD_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM.D_DATE_SK. Sale date. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: CS_SOLD_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to TIME_DIM.T_TIME_SK. Time of sale.

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM.D_DATE_SK. Date item was shipped. Can differ from sale date.

table_columns.name: CS_BILL_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER.C_CUSTOMER_SK. Customer who was billed. Use for revenue attribution.

table_columns.name: CS_BILL_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.CD_DEMO_SK. Demographics of billing customer.

table_columns.name: CS_BILL_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_DEMO_SK. Household demographics of billing customer.

table_columns.name: CS_BILL_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS.CA_ADDRESS_SK. Billing address.

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER.C_CUSTOMER_SK. Customer receiving the shipment. Can differ from billing customer (gift orders).

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.CD_DEMO_SK. Demographics of ship-to customer.

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_DEMO_SK.

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS.CA_ADDRESS_SK. Shipping address.

table_columns.name: CS_CALL_CENTER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CALL_CENTER.CC_CALL_CENTER_SK. Call center that processed the order.

table_columns.name: CS_CATALOG_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CATALOG_PAGE.CP_CATALOG_PAGE_SK. Catalog page the item was ordered from.

table_columns.name: CS_SHIP_MODE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to SHIP_MODE.SM_SHIP_MODE_SK. Shipping method chosen.

table_columns.name: CS_WAREHOUSE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to WAREHOUSE.W_WAREHOUSE_SK. Warehouse fulfilling the order.

table_columns.name: CS_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM.I_ITEM_SK. Part of composite primary key with CS_ORDER_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: CS_PROMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to PROMOTION.P_PROMO_SK. Promotion applied. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: CS_ORDER_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Order number grouping multiple line items. Use COUNT(DISTINCT CS_ORDER_NUMBER) for order counts.

table_columns.name: CS_QUANTITY
table_columns.description: Units ordered.

table_columns.name: CS_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Wholesale cost per unit.

table_columns.name: CS_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: List price per unit.

table_columns.name: CS_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Actual selling price per unit.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_DISCOUNT_AMT
table_columns.description: Total discount on this line item.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended sales price = CS_QUANTITY * CS_SALES_PRICE. Primary revenue field.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Extended wholesale cost.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended list price.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_TAX
table_columns.description: Tax on this line item.

table_columns.name: CS_COUPON_AMT
table_columns.description: Coupon discount applied.

table_columns.name: CS_EXT_SHIP_COST
table_columns.description: Shipping cost for this line item. Add to net paid for total order cost.

table_columns.name: CS_NET_PAID
table_columns.description: Amount paid after coupons, before tax.

table_columns.name: CS_NET_PAID_INC_TAX
table_columns.description: Net paid including tax.

table_columns.name: CS_NET_PAID_INC_SHIP
table_columns.description: Net paid including shipping cost.

table_columns.name: CS_NET_PAID_INC_SHIP_TAX
table_columns.description: Net paid including both shipping and tax. Total customer payment amount.

table_columns.name: CS_NET_PROFIT
table_columns.description: Net profit after all costs. Can be negative.
